root_cause: Only the Python/CPU variant of model_creation_sample (test[param3]) failed out of 218 smoke tests; the identical C++/CPU variant (param0-2) and the other Python variants (MULTI:CPU, AUTO; param4-5) passed. samples_common_test_class.py logs stderr via log.error(stderr) only when retcode != 0, but the captured log shows an empty ERROR line with no message body, meaning the subprocess produced no stderr text despite a non-zero return code. This is the same isolated single-parametrization, no-diagnostic-output signature previously recorded on 2026-11-03 (run 41606510649) for the identical test on the same Linux ARM64 workflow, consistent with a transient runner-level issue (process killed/raced on the ARM64 host) rather than a deterministic regression from the merged commit (#39446), which only touches the GPU plugin's primitive_inst.cpp/fully_connected_onednn.cpp and does not affect samples or Python sample scripts.
reproduction_steps: Not reliably reproducible outside CI. On a Linux ARM64 host after building/installing OpenVINO with samples: `python3 install/samples/python/model_creation_sample/model_creation_sample.py install/samples/cpp/model_creation_sample/lenet.bin CPU` and check the return code; run the full smoke suite with `pytest install/tests/smoke_tests -k test_model_creation_sample` repeatedly to try to reproduce the intermittent failure.
recommended_actions: Confirm this failure does not reproduce on the next master push (if it does not reproduce, this strengthens the Flaky Test / Infrastructure classification and no code change is needed).

Enhance samples_common_test_class.py (around line 339-340) to always log subprocess stdout in addition to stderr on failure, and log the retcode value itself, so future occurrences carry actionable diagnostics instead of an empty ERROR line.

Check ARM64 GitHub-hosted runner resource usage (memory/CPU) during the Samples job window (12:03 UTC) for signs of OOM or contention, since this is the second occurrence of an empty-stderr failure for this exact test on this workflow.

Since this signature has now recurred (2nd occurrence, both on Linux ARM64), consider adding a bounded automatic retry for isolated single-parametrization smoke test failures when all sibling parametrizations of the same sample pass.
prevention_strategies: Capture and log both stdout and stderr (and the retcode) unconditionally on sample test failures so intermittent runner-level issues can be distinguished from real regressions without needing extra re-run instrumentation. Add a bounded automatic retry for isolated single-parametrization smoke-test failures when all other parametrizations of the same sample pass, to reduce noise from transient runner issues while still surfacing systematic failures.
historical_context: This is the 2nd recorded occurrence of this exact signature (test_model_creation_sample.py::Test_model_creation_sample::test[Python-CPU] - AssertionError: Sample execution failed | Flaky Test). The first was recorded on 2026-11-03 (run 41606510649, PR #39251) with an identical symptom: single Python/CPU parametrization failing with empty stderr while all other parametrizations passed. That investigation also concluded Flaky Test/transient runner issue and found the triggering PR unrelated to samples code.
